matching_pages_notes: Original NARA PDF pages 55 through 64 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 414 previously unaudited printed rows on pages 55-59 and 61-64 were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed spelling and initials, suffixes, rank or grade, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Page 60 had already passed visual review; all 460 rows across the ten-page block agree with the current extraction. Literal source anomalies remain unchanged, including H., Jr. with a separate B initial, Virgina, Sevellon, Katehrine, Italian Ai, the nine-digit Buccina number, Buehler Carl with III in the initial field, Burgesono with the note possibly, Carnelealia, duplicated Marian H Burns rows, Mary Burton with the truncated note docume, Alfrd, Butyter, and Cabrerea. Private identifiers are not included in this review bundle or public assets.
